name: Yakumo Chizuru
source:
Chizuru has very girly taste, so most of the performances she plans are musicals about love and romance. She's the vice president of the Drama Club and she performs the lead role in plays. She adores [url=/c98281]Chika[/url], but Chika seems to be uncomfortable around her. She appears to harbor a crush on [url=/c98390]Mitsuru[/url].

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
